counting_rules: Nonverbose Go package successes are executed tests, not zero cases.
Compile-only package lines do not count as executed tests.
Named results include helper cases, nested subtests and fuzz seed cases.
Repeated platform/workflow executions are not distinct test names.
Windows workflow skips and platform-specific Python skips are not passes.

four_node_scenarios.scope: real shipped operator, active ledgers, funded Orchard four processes
real operator legacy-compatible funded end-to-end regression
real Rust wallet and worker behind four native consensus processes

funded_local_timing_samples_ms.scope: two samples per native run including backup/rescan, signed checks and replay; no p95/TPS/WAN claim

limitations: This is an independent retained-evidence review; no local native workload or live OS probe was rerun.
Rust target execution, all new append-plan test names, dynamic funded partition completeness and full native acceptance are assigned to a separate reviewer.
CI and independent agent review are not an external specialist cryptography or security audit.
All genuine payments use ephemeral NO-FUNDS local laboratory funding; no real-value transfer or deployment occurred.
Health, preflight, AppHash and local ApplyBlock are not finality.
Growth covers real local worker disk/replay, not 100000-block four-node consensus or physical power loss.
Fixed 32+1 resources are retained OS lifetime resident/working-set samples per process generation; not phase peaks, private heap, all-process totals or enforced allocation caps.
Python supervisor and Go coordinator are outside measured roles; scenario includes prover, cache, history, both wallets and Argon2.
Resource run remains one segment and does not measure archive/append-plan cost, 64-entry cache boundary, full storage capacity or maximum commitment count.
The setup artifact remains not_started; workload credit comes from final resource JSON plus matching completed native log and metadata.
precheckpoint_child_tree_cleanup_confirmed remains false; ordinary registered-role cleanup does not prove a process sandbox.
ZIP and manifest hashes prove retained member integrity and native source association, not independent binary reproducibility or a publisher signature.
The C2 stage remains a read-only append plan; persistent incremental backup and snapshot state import are not implemented; P2 remains in progress.
